title: You Stayed the Same
lyrics:
Through the Years I learned to Count
Empty Chairs among the crowd
faces faded with each season
like the shadows of the clouds

Spring turned to summer, gold to gray
Familiar faces slipped away
I slowly came to treat every goodbye
As something tied to another lie

You never swore that you would stay
you simply did day after day
When you spoke, there was no doubt
only hope came from your mouth

You said my name without restraint
Like it wasn't stained by my mistakes
you saw more than what I was
Though I thought you blind

I wore my shame so naturally
it fit like skin surrounding me
You looked at me so differently
Couldnt comprehend what you could see

Every time you held your ground
I waited for you to back down
I kept expecting you to leave
 because that's all I knew to be

You said my name like it was strong
Like I belonged here all along
I never said it aloud
But I survived to make you Proud

Storms came through then drifted off
our lives changes, new years dawned
Dreams grew large and my fears grew too
Still somehow there always was you

Never louder than the room
Never trying hard to prove
You never needed Perfect words
You were strong enough to be heard

When my whole world seemed to rearrange
Somehow you stayed the same
You never dragged me toward the light
Or argued my darkness that night

You let silence do its part
Trusted time with my heart
When I disappeared for weeks
Somewhere far out of reach

You never made my absence shame
you stayed the same, you stayed the same
Though valleys stretched beyond my sight
you never doubted I'd see the light

No matter what the wind had blown
Or places I've wandered lone
you held a faith I couldn't see
The kind of hope that carried me

You saw me through the eyes of Christ
When I had given up the fight
I thought your hope belonged to you
Something I could never Prove

Now I wonder if instead
You simply saw the road ahead
Looking back it's strange to see
You never came to rescue me

Or to fight wars in my stead
Just stood your ground when my hope was dead
you simply stood through every season
Never asking for a reason

Long enough for me to find
The strength you always said was mine
I won't pretend I walked alone
Because of you I stand on my Own

You gave me room to find my pace
and never asked me to be replaced
I am the man you saw in me
Now standing here Finally Free
Finally Free

title: Where the Night has Led
lyrics:
We learned the house by passing hours
Between the cracks of borrowed power
The walls remembered every shout,
We learned which doors we could slip out.

If there was peace, it lived past ten,
When everyone had slept again.
The night we kept was never tame,
two brothers laughing all the same.

I watched the seasons change your face,
Saw quiet settle in your place.
You chased horizons I couldn't find;
I stayed behind, but was on your side.

No matter where the night has led,
Or how the dark surrounds your steps,
You don't have to bear that weight alone.
If you call, I'll bring you home.

I saw you drift where shadows grew
Chasing highs I never knew
The weight they leave when daylight fades
Or what remains after peace falls to raids

You carried more than I could take,
Learned to bend so you wouldn't break.
I watched you learn the world’s demand
Then give more than you could stand

I've seen the silence in your eyes,
The words that never truly died.
You don’t have to set it straight
I know how long you’ve carried hate.

No matter where the night has led,
Or if the road runs cold instead,
If you can't see beyond your feet,
I'll walk every mile till we meet.

I don't need yesterday returned,
Or every bridge rebuilt that burned.
I still see the boy you were
And the man you’re becoming; not a blur

The years can leave their weathered stain,
But they don't measure what remains.
You're more than all the hurt you've known;
You'll never have to face it alone.

I won’t pretend I know the way
Or fix what’s broken in a day
But every step you choose to take
Is ground I’ll stand on for your sake

But if your strength begins to bend,
Or hope feels thinner at the end,
Then take one step; and I'll take two.
If your path breaks, I'll follow through.

No matter where your footsteps fall,
Or if you stumble after all,
However long you need, I'll stay;
I'll stay beside you, every day.

title: At Every Gate
lyrics:
They told me love would find its way
If I just learned to wait and stay
Every closed door meant somehow
I missed the mark, I missed the vow

I learned to carry quiet doubt
read the signs, they left me out
They said you'll know it when it's right
So I kept reaching through the night


Every hand I held too tight
Let go without a single fight
mistook borrowed heat
For something real that cut too deep

Kept mistaking want for need
Learned I shouldn't plead
If this is how it's meant to feel
Why does it never feel real?

You wore my hope like it was light
Something to use, not something right
You took my yes, ignored my no
Then said that's just the way love goes

I stayed too long to prove I could
Make something work when nothing would
You left me holding what we were
and walked away without a word

I learned the cost of staying still
Calling control a test of will
If this is love the way they say
Why do I lose myself this way?

I was a place you passed through warm
A Steady place to ride the storm
You took what helped you feel okay
Then called it time and walked away

I won't keep shrinking just to stay
Or bend myself the way you say
If love requires less of me
Then our love was never meant to be

They say the right one shows up late
But I was there at every gate
I won't keep waiting to be seen
I know exactly what I mean

I won't mistake this calm for loss
I'll just stand here and hold my cross
I've learned that being left behind
Doesn't make the failing mine

I don't need love to prove I'm whole
I finally stand inside my soul

title: Something You'll Never See
lyrics:
I learned the shape of empty rooms
And how the quiet never blooms
I waited by the open door
For steps I’d only heard before

The seasons shifted as I stayed
While light met dark in quiet shade
Some stories end before they start
Some shadows never learn their part

When the night pressed in too close
And every thought became a ghost
I carried absence like a name
Too young to know I’m not to blame

I chased reflections down the glass
To find the truth of what would pass
The mirror held a stranger’s face
Detached from any rightful place

I learned to speak without a claim
To bear the weight without a name
You burned the bridge before I crossed
And left me guessing what was lost

When the night pressed in with spite
And every echo begged for fight
I wore the cold you left behind
And built a wall inside my mind

I spent those years without a claim
Thinking my flaws were mine to tame
If Loving me Required More
Too easy to just leave before

I learned that I was built to lose
Too small a thing for you to choose
I wore that truth without a sound
And shrank until I wasn’t found

If I was never worth the stay
Then leaving was your only way
I made that truth a part of me
And carried it so quietly

But later, when the noise withdrew
And life made space for something true
I found a quiet in the air
That didn’t answer, but was there

It never argued with my pain
Or tried to give my wounds a name
It simply stayed through every doubt
A steady ground I learned about

The years moved on, and so did I
No longer asking reasons why
The man I am is truly free
You played no part in who I'd be

Your absence holds no claim on me
I grew into something you’ll never see

title: Finally Loved
lyrics:
I learned to wait without a sound
While your world kept spinning round
You built your home where love felt new
And left me learning what to do

You searched for worth in someone’s eyes
Kept falling for all of their lies
I don’t believe you meant the cost
but somewhere in there we both got lost

You were around, but not aware
Of what was breaking in your care
I learned to carry what I could
And keep it quiet like I should

I watched the walls grow thin at night
Learned how to read a room by sight
You stayed so tired, kept it moving
Missed the cost of what was brewing

I learned the weight of silent stress
And how to step around the mess
Not every bruise is meant to show
Some teach you things you shouldn’t know

You carried more than you could show
Doing your best just to keep us whole
You gave your strength to keep us fed
But missed the signs inside our head

I needed safety, not a fight
A softer place to land at night
I don’t deny the cost it made
But I survived the price I paid

I see you standing calmer now
In something real, not just a vow
He treats you kind, he shows up right
And I can breathe a little light

I don’t rewrite the years before
Or close the wounds they left in store
But I can smile at where you are now
And not need more than what that allows

I see you lighter than before
Not bracing for another war
I’m glad you found a place to stay
Where love doesn’t ask you to look away

We cant go back to what we were before
I hope you're happy forevermore
You found your calm, and thats enough
Im glad youre finally loved.

title: Unfinished Melody
lyrics:
You don't get to take the good ones first...
Then tell us not to curse.
Call it fate if that's what you want
only makes it hurt that much worse.

You don't get to still my hands...
or silence our demands.
Some songs aren't meant to fade.
Some are torn before they're played.

The clock still moves ahead...
Like nothing's changed, like no one's bled.
The world keeps moving, blind and loud...
I stand motionless in the crowd.

I cursed the days that dared go on
As if your leaving broke the dawn
The world keeps dancing to its song...
While I'm alone denying that you're gone.

I hated hearing,
"Time will heal."
As if they knew
That death would steal.

I shouted your name into the gray...
Every breath a plea to stay.
Half convinced if Heaven heard...
It might let me have one more word.

But every echo came back as mine.
No matter how I begged for more time.
Silence has a way...
Of showing that the emptiness is here to stay.

You wouldn't want me drowned in grief...
Or to see me abandon my belief.
You always dreamed to see me grow...
So I'll live the life you'll never know.

I'm still angry.
I won't lie.
Some wounds don't fade...
Forever Cry.

I hated those who still had time...
As if joy was stealing what was mine.

But you would never ask that cost...
Or want me bitter from your loss.
You showed me how to live...
love is all you had to give.

So I'll let your memory shape my days...
Not as a wound, but as a way.

If Heaven needed you more than me...
I won't call it betrayal...
Just grief.

I'll carry love—though not complete...
And sing it soft, this unfinished melody.

(Instrumental.  Wordless scream.)

title: An Empty Stool
lyrics:
The place still smells like yesterday
Wood and glass, the usual gray
Same low lights, same crooked sign
Same empty seat right next to mine

I order two without a thought
Habit’s faster than what I forgot
The bartender don’t ask me why
Just sets it down and lets it lie

I talk to you like you’re still late
Like traffic caught you at the gate
I say the things we always said
About nothing much, about what's ahead

I tell you work’s the same old fight
Small wins, longer nights
I laugh where you would shake your head
And pause where you’d have said instead

The stool still creaks like it remembers
Boots on tile, late Decembers
Stories worn down smooth with time
Like scars you never drew a line

You carried weight you didn’t name
Shouldered it quiet, played the game
You stood your watch, you held your ground
Then disappeared without a sound

I won’t pretend I know the why
Or trace the moment you passed by
I won’t dress it up or make it clean
I leave it sitting in between

I sit a while, then raise my glass
Just let this moment pass at last
No speeches, no more words
Just me and you, an empty stool

I hope you enjoyed your beer
Just wish you had held life dear

title: My Breath
lyrics:
I sat where nothing asked of me
No role to play, no need to be
The moment held me soft and slow
Like time had nowhere else to go

I felt the noise begin to fade
Like distant storms that never stayed
The world kept moving past my view
But I stayed still and let it through

I noticed air move in my chest
A gentle rise, a gentle rest
No one calling me away
Just here enough to let it stay

I breathe it in, I breathe it out
Let go of fear, let go of doubt
No need to hurry, nor to chase
I’m safe enough inside this space

I let the minutes drift on by
No need to ask the reasons why
Each moment came, then let me be
And passed along peacefully

I didn’t need to fix a thing
Or name the peace this moment brings
I stayed where nothing had to prove
And let the silence gently move

I breathe it in, I breathe it out
Let go of fear, let go of doubt
No need to hurry, nor to chase
I’m safe enough inside this space

I stayed until the moment passed
No future pulled me from the past
Just here, where time is soft and slow
Enough to rest, enough to know

I let the moment come and rest
I learn to live inside my breath

title: When Days Felt New
lyrics:
I stepped beyond the lines I’d drawn
And felt the pull of a new dawn
The air was thin with different sound
Like something lost had just been found

I watched the rhythm shape the day
In ways I’d never learned to say
Every gesture, every sign
Felt deliberate, calm, aligned

I followed paths I couldn’t name
Let motion be the only aim
Each crossing asked me who I’d be
If I stopped chasing certainty

I learned the language of the street
In passing glances, bowed retreats
The city breathed a patient pace
Like time had found a softer place

I was searching for escape
Just room enough to change my shape
Somewhere between the steps I took
I felt my life begin to look

Like something more than just a plan
Like something built by where I stand
Each open road began to show
A life I’m finally meant to know

I didn’t leave to lose my name
Or outrun guilt or dodge the blame
I wasn’t chasing something new
Just space to see what still rang true

Each step unfastened what was tight
Each breath returned a sense of light
I wasn’t lost — I was in view
Of who I’d be when days felt new

I see the world with open eyes
No need to rush, no need to rise
Every horizon draws me near
To something bright and something clear


I learned to walk without a map
To trust the space between each gap
Every step became a choice
To move ahead and find my voice

I let the moment speak its name
And felt the awe I couldn’t claim
The beauty of what you create
Was shown to me by my own fate

title: Only Sound
lyrics:
I wake where every thought stands armed
A thousand signals sound alarms
I sort the static from the sound
And mark the places I can’t ground

Some days the air feels counterfeit
Like truth keeps slipping bit by bit
I take one breath, I hold the line
Remind myself this voice is mine

This is the war I never chose
Where every thought writhes and sows
Some lead me out, some pull me low
Some fleeting — crying like a crow

I’m not the noise inside my head
Not the words they wish I said
I stand right here, I take my ground
I hear the fight — I am the sound

They speak in tones I almost trust
Hiding blades covered in rust
They circle close, they strafe my faith
And swear they’re here to keep me safe

They borrow truth, then bend its frame
And swear it’s love when it’s just blame
They know the shape of all my fears
They wear my past like souvenirs

This is the war I never chose
Where every thought still twists and grows
Some call me lost, some call me whole
Some shake the faith I try to hold

I’m not the noise inside my head
Not every fear they’ve dressed and fed
I stand right here, I take my ground
I hear the fight — but I am sound

Some days they tell me I’m a fraud
That every step I took was flawed
They count my scars like borrowed debt
And call it proof I should regret

Other days they crown my spine
Say I’m chosen, say I’m fine
That’s when I learn to disengage
Too much light hides this cage

I’ve learned the cost of constant stress
Of mistaking volume for a threat
A steady pulse, an anchored heart
I hold the line, I don’t depart

I don’t erase what I’ve been through
I just decide what’s speaking true
If I am standing, there’s no fear
I am more than what’s in here

This is the war I never chose
Where every thought still comes and goes
Some pass me by, some pull me near
Some fade like echoes, disappear

I’m not the noise inside my head
Not the lies that beg to be fed
I stand right here, I take my ground
I see the fight — but it’s only sound

title: Sacred Flame
lyrics:
I’ve been counting every prayer
Wondering if You’re even there
I speak into the sky
But never hear Your reply

I keep my faith between my hands
Still hoping You might understand
If silence is the path You choose
Why does it always feel like I lose

If You’re there, then say my name
I’m tired of calling into flame
I stand on words I still hold true
But faith won’t ever answer You

I said I’d change the way I live
If You would show me what to give
I cut myself down to the bone
Just to prove I was alone

I tried to earn what should be free
Turned every prayer to currency
If faith is built on what I trade
Why do I still come up unpaid

If You’re there, then say my name
I kept my vows, I bore the blame
I followed every sign You drew
So why am I still chasing You

You watched me fall and never moved
Left me bloody and bruised
If this was love You meant to show
Why does it hurt more then I know

I tore the altar from my chest
Let silence answer all the rest
I stopped pretending You were near
And named the thing I felt as fear

I didn’t need You to explain
Or wash the blood out of the pain
I just needed You to stay
When I had nothing left to say

I didn’t curse You, didn’t pray
Just let the days keep passing gray
I set belief down on the floor
And stopped expecting anymore

I let the symbols lose their names
And watched the days slip out of frames
I carried weight without a why
Just staring holes into the sky

I started listening for more
Not signs or fire like before
Just watching where the cracks appeared
And  was still standing when it cleared

I found You in the quiet ground
Not in the signs I chased around
You weren’t the voice I tried to hear
You were the breath that kept me near

I learned You can’t be bought or weighed
Or earned by vows I never made
You met me empty, unprepared
And stayed before I even dared

You were there, You knew my name
You held the spark of the sacred flame
I stand on ground I know to be
And faith is here with me

I won’t pretend I understand
Or trace Your steps across the land
I only know I’m not alone
Even when the road is stone

I don’t demand the skies to part
I carry You within my heart
I lost the answers I once chased
But kept the faith that took their place

title: Proof for Me
lyrics:
You learned the world before your name
I held the quiet, learned the same
You reached for sounds you couldn’t see
And one of them came out as me

I was too young to know the way
But I showed up night after day
If all you keep is just that sound
Know it was real while I was around

I didn’t choose the shape of loss
Some roads divide without a cross
I learned that love can still be true
Even when it can’t stay with you

Walk the line that lets you sleep
Keep your word, even when it’s deep
Choose the kind that doesn’t scar
And be proud of who you are

You’re finding edges, testing ground
Learning which voices make which sounds
Some doors look bright but close too fast
Some moments ask for more than last

Take time to know the weight of choice
And trust the calm inside your voice
Not every crowd is worth the cost
Not every win is worth the loss

I won’t pretend I know your days
Or see the paths your footsteps trace
But every good you choose to be
Is more than enough proof for me

If you fall short, don’t lose your way
Stand back up and face the day
You’re more than moments you regret
There’s good ahead you haven’t met

I don’t need credit for your name
Or proof you ever felt the same
Just know that somewhere, standing still
I held you then — and always will

Walk the line that lets you sleep
Keep your word, even when it’s deep
Choose the kind that makes you whole
And guard the good inside your soul

I won’t ask you to look back
Or carry weight you never lacked
Just live the life that feels like true
And know I’m proud of you

title: Echoes
lyrics:
I wake up where the silence breathes
Every thought inside me seethes
I’ve learned the shape of all these walls
I know the echo when it calls

I made a truce with all the noise
Stopped asking for a different choice
This is where my story ends
I’ve learned some things never mend

I stopped fighting what I hear
Just to make it through the fear
If this is all I’m meant to be
I’ll learn to live where I can’t see

This is the sound of breaking slow
Talking to ghosts I used to know
I keep my wounds out of sight
Still breathing through another night

I’ve walked these halls a thousand times
Memorized the warning signs
Every promise left a scar
Drew a line from afar

They say “trust” like it’s some door
Like I haven’t bled there before
So I stand completely on guard
Just to keep from falling hard

You can’t see the war I face
Just to stand here in this place
Every breath taken is not for free
But I’m still here — I will be me

This is the sound of holding on
When every reason says you’re wrong
Might be mistaken, but faith isn’t gone
I’ve been fighting all along

I was told I’d never change
That I’d always stay this strange
You won’t see the burden that I bear
You just turn away -- you're never there

I walked through hell and didn’t fall
I wouldn’t fade — but lost it all
You stood so close, but still alone
I made it out on my own

This is the sound of breaking free
This is the price of forsaking me
You watched me be buried alive
But I’m still here — I will survive

I still hear echoes in the air
But they don’t hold me in their snare
I’m not the dark I had to fight
I found my breath — I will take flight

This is the sound of being me
After all, I’m finally free

title: Never Again
lyrics:
I know the shape of who I was
The easy lie, the quiet shrug
The borrowed rooms, the open hands
The half-made vows, the shifting plans

I wore excuses like a coat
Called drifting just a different note
Said “someday” like it meant today
And let my better self decay

No one forced that life on me
I chose the smaller version, free
Free from risk, from failing loud
Free from standing firm and proud

That comfort nearly made a grave
A softer cage I almost stayed
No locks, no bars — just slow decline
A life that asked for nothing of mine

I built this spine the harder way
Through every doubt I didn’t obey
Through doors that closed and nights that burned
Through lessons paid and ground I earned

I proved the voices wrong with time
Rewrote the script, redrew the line
I know the man I fought to be
And what it cost to set me free

And now the sky is wide and clear
And that’s what brings the quiet fear
It’s not the fall or failing loud
It’s fading back into the crowd

The echoes linger, faint and thin
Not pulling like they once had been
They whisper soft, “Just take a rest.
You’ve proved enough. You did your best.

I know those voices. I know their tone.
They offer peace — but it’s a loan.
They ask for inches, not the fall.
But one step back could cost it all

Never again.
Not one retreat.
Not one excuse I won’t defeat.
Not one old comfort dressed as fate.
Not one unlocked, familiar gate.

I am not who I was before.
I won’t live small behind that door.
If fear is what keeps watch at night,
Then fear can stand be hide the light.

I didn’t fight to stand this tall
To trade it back for something small.
If I am tired, I’ll rest, not run.
I may be scared, but I'm not done

Never again, Not quietly.
Not slowly back to who I’d be.
I know what it cost to rise.
I guard it now with open eyes.

title: Coming Blow
lyrics:
Stone set high and windows sealed
No open gate, no ground revealed
The watchfires burn against the night
I brace for wars I’ll never fight

The crown is new, the walls are thin
I know what waits if they get within
I’ve seen what cracks can cost a throne
I won’t let ruin claim my own

I stand guard at every wall.
No crack too small, to risk it all.
No open gate, no lowered spear.
No quiet voice gets welcomed here.

No banners rise. No horns are blown
No siege is laid against my stone
The fields lie quiet, wide and bright
Yet I stay braced for distant might

A voice outside the outer gate
No blade in hand. No sign of hate
No army formed. No battle cry
Just someone asking, “Can I try?”

I stand guard at every wall.
No crack too small, to risk it all.
But if you speak beyond the stone,
I won’t pretend I’m here alone.

The stones still hold. The crown is mine
No breach runs deep beneath the line
The gate stays watched, strong at night.
No need to brace for every fight.

The cracks I feared were mostly air
Old echoes speaking of despair
Not every sound’s a warning sign
Not every shadow crosses mine

I stand guard — the crown is mine.
The walls still hold. The gates align.
Not every knock’s a battle cry.
Some come to stay. And so will I.

The echoes fade. The watch grows still.
No shadow moves against my will.
I keep my post — but now I know
Not every wind’s a coming blow.

title: Nothing at All
lyrics:
I watch the ceiling hold its shape
Like it’s bracing for a quake
Every thought comes dressed as sense
Every answer feels like defense

I scroll through fires I didn’t light
Everyone’s wrong, everyone’s right
Every truth reduced to a side
Every breath tastes a little like pride

I’ve got words, but none that heal
None that won’t sharpen what I feel
If honesty just makes it crawl
I’ll say nothing at all

I learned young what silence costs
What they take, and what is lost
I did the work, I played it straight
Still watched luck choose like it’s fate

Some are born with open doors
Some kick walls until they’re sore
They call it merit, call it owed
I just watch the distance grow

I could speak, but it would burn
Every bridge I haven’t earned
If truth has teeth and wants to maul
I’ll say nothing at all

I don’t trust the shape of crowds
Or the way they sound so proud
Every vow comes with a knife
Every fix demands my life

I’ve seen belief turn into law
Seen mercy labeled as a flaw
Every side swears they’re the cure
And calls conviction something pure

I’ve got nothing nice to say
About the road we’re on this way
If silence is the safest call
I’ll say nothing at all

This isn’t fear
It’s recognition
This isn’t peace
It’s  supposition

I don’t think shouting saves a thing
Or that truth survives the ring
Nor will adding to the sound
Stop the structure falling down

I won’t dress rot up as hope
Or call the fall a learning slope
If every word just feeds the fall
I’ll just say nothing at all

I see it clear
I feel the fear
I’ve said enough
Nothing at all

title: White Noise
lyrics:
I wake before the sun can rise
Already drowning in replies
A thousand signals crowd my head
Half alive and half misread

I know the list of what to do
It stares at me like something new
The simplest step becomes a wall
My body won’t respond at all

The hours bleed without a sound
I pace the same two feet of ground
I want to move, I want to start
But static locks me in the dark

It’s not a lack of will or care
It’s like the air is never there
My mind runs laps at triple speed
My hands won’t follow what I need

There’s white noise crawling through my veins
A thousand unfinished lanes
Every thought demands the lead
Every spark outpaces need

I fake a calm, I fake control
While chaos digs into my soul
They say “just focus,” “just begin”
Like I don’t fight this war within

I watch the clock turn threat to shame
Every minute fans the flame
I call myself what I’m not worth
Like all I am is endless dearth

I hate the gap from want to done
The war I lose before it’s begun
I know the man I’m meant to be
He feels miles ahead of me

The noise says quit, you’re built to stall
You’ll always crash before the call
It counts the proof, it stacks the blame
It knows my fear, it knows my name

But here’s the truth beneath the sound
I’m still here standing on this ground
If I was weak, I’d never fight
This hard to stand up every night

This isn’t laziness or ease
It’s running through electric seas
It’s dragging weight no one can see
And still refusing not to be

I don’t need perfect, don’t need clean
I just need one small in-between
One breath, one task, one forward inch
One choice that doesn’t make me flinch

The static screams that I can’t move
But I’ve got nothing left to prove
I break it down to what is next
One single word, one line of text

I am not broken, not a lie
Not every missed and almost try
My brain is loud, my path is steep
But I still wake, I still keep

I won’t compare my pace to theirs
Or measure worth by finished squares
If all I win tonight is a start
That still counts inside this heart

The noise can rage, it can be loud
It doesn’t get to wear my crown
I am the will beneath the storm
The steady pulse, the anchored form

I may not sprint when others run
But I still rise when day is done
White noise can scream until it’s hoarse
I choose one step — and change its course

If all I do is fight to stand
That doesn’t mean my fate is damned
I’m not the static in my head
I’m the voice that moves instead

And even when it feels too late
And shame is pounding at the gate
I am still here — still in the fight
And that is how I win tonight

title: Restrained
lyrics:
I read the email, felt it land
Another door slammed shut and banned
Same empty words, polite and clean
Like failure’s something unforeseen

I shut the screen, I shut my mouth
I felt it rise without a sound
A heat I’ve learned to keep below
A thing I never let them know

I’ve counted time in silent no’s
In resumes no one chose
I built a life they’ll never see
And buried it in uncertainty

I held my breath, I held my ground
Until my footing wasn’t sound
then something older took the wheel
And didn’t care what I would feel

There’s a monster in my chest
That doesn’t want what’s best
It doesn’t plan, it doesn’t pray
It just wants everything to decay

It tore the proof out of my hands
Like it was never part of the plans
Everything built and the miles I flew
All felt like lies I once knew

I watched it burn and felt it sting
Like losing didn’t change a thing
If none of it was meant to last
Why keep the weight of what has passed

It speaks in heat, it speaks in force
It never asks, it sets its course
To break the mirror, break the wall
To make sure nothing stands at all

It doesn’t care what I become
It just wants silence, just wants done
It wants the end without the cost
No future, no more being lost

There’s a monster in my chest
That thinks destruction’s whats best
It says if nothing’s left to lose
Then nothing's left to be abused

But rage is honest, not precise
It never asks me for the price
It burns the house to feel the heat
Then wonders why there’s no retreat

I let it scream, take its toll
But can’t let it take control
I hear it out, then draw the line
It speaks in ways that don’t align

There’s a monster in my chest
I know its pull, I know its test
But wanting ruin isn’t truth
What’s waiting here I can’t yet soothe

I didn’t win. I didn’t break.
I forced it quiet, stayed awake.
It’s not asleep, it’s just restrained.
I stay alert and bear the blame.

title: Dust
lyrics:
I held your words like they were law
The clearest truth I ever saw
The nights felt bright beneath your laugh
Like broken roads had found a path

You stood above the doubts I knew
The world felt smaller next to you
I thought the dark we shared was light
A refuge carved from endless night

I called that bond the best I’d known
A truth that couldn’t be overthrown

I placed you high where none could fall
The strongest voice above them all
I thought the height was built from trust
But marble cracks beneath its dust

The jokes ran loud, the nights ran long
We called the drifting “staying strong”
You said the world would never bend
So why pretend you weren't my friend

I let those words become my frame
A quiet shield against the game
If nothing waits beyond this door
Then striving wasn’t worth the war

The comfort there felt safe enough
A place that praised when I gave up

I placed you high where none could fall
The clearest sight above it all
But cracks appeared beneath the rust
And truth began to shift the dust

The laughs grew sharp, the air turned thin
A hidden weight beneath the grin
A hand that struck when words went wrong
A silence stretching far too long

The hope we buried stayed that way
While every dream was pushed to grey
You called the world a losing fight
And pulled me farther from the light

I saw the cost of standing still
A quiet cage dressed up as will

I placed you high without a pause
But height can’t hide your flaws
The view I praised began to rust
The pedestal was only dust

The years moved on, the distance grew
A clearer sky replaced that view
I saw the path I’d never tried
Because your shadows stood beside

The words you spoke began to fade
Like echoes drifting through the shade
Not enemies — just voices lost
Inside the weight of their own cost

I felt the ground beneath my feet
And chose a road you couldn’t meet

I placed you high where none could fall
But I won’t answer to that call
The place you held I cannot trust
The pedestal returned to dust

I won’t erase the years we shared
The nights we laughed, the weight we bared
But time reveals what once was blind
And frees the ground beneath the mind

You taught me more than you could see
By showing what I’d never be
The life I want is built from trust
Not shadows clinging to their dust

I placed you high above it all
But truth will answer every call
The path ahead is built from trust
And I will leave the dust to dust

title: A Need to Be
lyrics:
I thought this through before the call
I almost didn’t dial at all
There’s nothing here they’d classify
But silence hasn’t helped me try

(911, what’s your emergency?)

I don’t know if this applies
Nothing wrong you’d recognize
No blood loss and nothing broke
But something in me lost its hope

I followed every marked escape
Signed my name on every shape
Degrees stacked neat beside the wall
Proof I answered every call

Three long years of dialing out
Every silence turned to doubt
I did my best to avoid regret
but buried myself deep in debt

No sirens needed where I stand
Just empty space where life was planned
No scene to tape, no crash to see
Just absence where a life should be

(Are you in danger?)

Not from anything you’d trace
Just slowly fading from this place
No sudden act, no violent end
Just a wound the effort couldn’t mend

(Where are you?)

Somewhere under all I’ve done
Every race I thought I’d won
Sitting on a mountain high
Made of every failed reply

(Are you alone?)

Yeah I think that’s finally clear
No one else is needed here
I talk but nothing answers back
My words just vanish into black

I built a future piece by piece
But progress never signed release
Every step that should have led
Just loops me back inside my head

No injury the eye can trace
Just something missing from its place
No moment where it all went wrong
Just nothing proving I belong

(How can we help?)

You can’t fix what isn’t broke
You can’t give meaning to this joke
You can’t return the time I gave
Or tell me what these years all saved

No form fits what I became
No box can hold a silent name
No emergency to send
Just waiting for a point to end

The monster doesn’t shout tonight
It only shrugs and dims the light
It says the math was always clear
You tried — the answer isn’t here

Not failure, not a tragic end
Just effort that will never bend
Toward anything that answers why
A life keeps choosing not to die

(I’m sorry… we can't send help for this.)

You did your job, you followed through
There’s nothing left for you to do
No threat, no crime, no life to save
Just someone trying not to cave

The line goes dead — and so does the plea
The choice is simple — just a need to be

title: My Reason Why
lyrics:
I play my role, I always run
Send hope out like it weighs a ton
I lace my will like worn-out shoes
And walk the roads I didn’t choose

I send my name into the void
Where silence sharpens, unannoyed
Each door is shut without a sound
Like effort never hit the ground

I’ve learned the cost of empty will
Of staring down and standing still
Hope wears thin, then breaks its thread
But I keep moving straight ahead

I don’t need proof to hold my ground
I don’t need echoes to resound
I don’t demand the sky reply
I breathe — and that’s my reason why

I’ve watched the fire dim to ash
Felt effort get labeled trash
They say to pivot, say to bend
Like giving up is how you mend

I’ve tasted anger, sharp and fast
But what rage can build doesn’t last
It burns the map to feel control
Then leaves you stranded with the toll

So I learned patience isn’t pause
It’s  not choosing action without cause
It’s setting anchors in the storm
And standing firm without a form

I don’t need signs to justify
The ground I claim, the line I try
I don’t need fate to shake my hand
I’m still here — that’s where I stand

Some days I feel the weight cave in
Like every try is wearing thin
Then thoughts creep in my soul
Like rest is found in letting go

Quitting whispers dressed as peace
It promises relief, sweet release
I hear it speak — I see the frame
It offers quiet,  no one to blame

I won’t confuse the end for rest
Or trade my spine for something less
If I fall, I'll fall moving ahead
Not kneeling to words unsaid

I don’t need victory in sight
To take another step tonight
I don’t need to see the end
Just a faith that never bends

It isn’t hoping things work out
It's moving forward through the doubt
trusting ground you can’t yet see
And standing where you’re meant to be

Been knocked down more times than I can count
Watched certainty erode what I couldn’t surmount
But something deeper took its place
A will no silence can erase

I don’t need doors to open wide
To know I’m meant to be inside
I don’t need answers carved in stone
I keep moving forward, not alone

If something better waits ahead
It waits because I haven’t fled
I don’t chase ease, I don’t pretend
I walk this road until it bends

I didn’t break. I didn’t quit.
I carried faith when proof wasn’t lit
The world stayed quiet — I stayed alive.
I breathe. And that’s my reason why.

title: Beneath the Ache
lyrics:
I learned the comfort of being stall
The quiet shrink, the smaller call
No crashing wave, no sudden break
Just slow erosion I’d mistake

For safety dressed in softer skin
A life that didn’t ask to win
No risk to lose, no heights to take
Just dull persistence I could fake

I sign my name beneath the ache
I endure the hurt that keeps me awake

The days went by without a scar
But nothing moved me very far
A steady throb beneath my palm
A hidden fracture in the calm

I told myself that this was fine
No bleeding edge, no steep incline
But something in me had to shake
From carrying weight I wouldn’t take

I sign my name beneath the ache
I bear the hurt that keeps me awake

It wasn’t pain that broke my will
It was the drift of standing still
The cost of staying safe and small
Was heavier than any fall

I’ve tasted both — the loss, the strain
Hollow comfort and honest pain
One drains you slow and leaves you small
One breaks you down to build you tall

I sign my name beneath the ache
I’m learning which pain’s mine to take

There’s pain that shrinks you to your knees
And pain that builds what you can be
One steals your voice and dims your sight
One burns but leaves you standing upright

The needle, light, the sterile air
The gym at dawn when no one’s there
The silent screen that reads “not now”
The vow to love and show up somehow

Each one could shrink me where I stand
Or make me stronger when I land
The cost of growth is never fake
It shapes the ground your steps will make

I sign my name beneath the ache
I take the hurt for growth’s own sake

I used to run from anything
That threatened comfort’s quiet ring
But numbness has a deeper price
It trades your edge for something nice

And I have lived that smaller fate
Watched safer roads evaporate
If pain will come, then let it break
The parts in me that need to wake

I sign my name beneath the ache
I choose the hurt that keeps me awake

I won’t mistake relief for grace
Or hide behind a slower pace
If pain must come for me to wake
Then let me sharpen when I ache

I sign my name — I won’t forsake
The pain that taught me how to wake

title: On the Other Side
lyrics:
The room is quiet, lights turned low
My pulse still loud from what I know
That flash of red, that spike of fear
Too much at once — too sharp, too near

The sink still stained inside my mind
A moment I can’t quite rewind
I chose this path — I knew the cost
But didn’t plan to feel this lost

I know it hurts. I know it’s slow.
I bear this weight you didn’t know.

You lie awake and count the strain
And wonder if you’d choose this pain
Not questioning why you doubt
Just shaken by the way it played out

The body trembles, breath runs tight
The dark feels heavier at night
And doubt comes easy in this place
Where strength feels slow and hard to trace

You’ve faced the flame and dared confront
And sworn you’d reached your final front
You’ve hit the wall and felt it win
Then found another way to begin

This is no different than before.
It feels like less — but it is more.

The clot that broke, the rush, the mess
Was shock — not some dark omen’s guess
It scared you hard, it caught you wrong
But you’re still here — and that is strong

You are not fading in this night.
You’re healing slow — and that takes fight.

The body mends where you can’t see
Beneath the pain, quietly
It builds in places torn apart
Long before it feels like a start

This surgery, this weight, this scar
Is not a measure of who you are
It’s proof you faced what had to be
And chose the path toward being free

You won’t stay trapped in sheets and doubt
This is a crossing — not a route
You’re passing through, not settling in
This is repair beneath the skin

On the other side of this
The breath will feel like bliss
The mirror won’t reflect this strain
Or echo back tonight’s sharp pain

On the other side you’ll stand
Not untouched — but stronger than planned
The version lying here unsure
If pushing on is worth the cure

On the other side of this
You won’t replay each drop and hiss
Of doubt that tried to pull you thin
You’ll only know you walked within

And when you stand in light restored
You won’t need proof of what you endured
The night will shrink, I'll stay and pray
But not the fear that ruled today

On the other side of pain
You’ll see what you have gained

title: Without a Roof
lyrics:
They told me what my life would be
A caution sign, a liability
Said “Some are built to barely cope”
And wrote the end of my hope

They measured me in fragile terms
Predicted failures in return
Said living lone was not my lane
Said striving high would end in pain

I signed my name beneath their doubt
Let their forecast map me out
Almost wore it like a crown
Almost let it lock me down

Years went by in waiting rooms
Soft-lit lies and quiet dooms
Every “no” became the proof
I was built with a lower roof

I learned to shrink before I tried
Call retreat a safer side
Let comfort act like it was wise
Watched something in me slowly die

But comfort isn’t peace — it’s slow
It keeps you small where you won’t grow
It pads the fall before you leap
And buries hunger down too deep

So I tore the script they handed me
Not loud — just stubbornly
I walked into the fear they named
And let it test the frame

Four years crawling toward a start
Seven months to prove my heart
The pace was never clean or fast
But forward motion still counts as past

They said the market’s closed and tight
That effort doesn’t mean you’re right
Twenty-seven thousand doors
Still standing here on battered floors

There’s a monster in my chest
It says collapse would serve me best
It says the numbers make it clear
You’re wasting breath, there’s nothing here

It speaks in heat, it speaks in blame
It calls persistence just a game
It wants me kneeling to the sound
It wants me thinking I’ve been crowned

But rage is honest — not precise
It never calculates the price
It burns the house to feel control
Then leaves you with an empty role

I hear it.
I know its tone.
I won’t let it run the throne.

Held back isn’t held down.
Silence isn’t a crown.
Progress slow is still progress made.
Effort given isn’t betrayed.

I am not the doors that close.
Not the market’s rise and lows.
Not the count of who replied.
Not the metrics I’ve supplied.

They said I’d never stand alone.
I built degrees from borrowed stone.
They said I’d never carry weight.
I outgrew every labeled fate.

If I fall, I fall in stride.
Not curled up where doubt resides.
If I lose, I lose upright.
Still choosing forward in the fight.

Held back is not held down.
Noise is not my crown.
The pace is mine, the line is drawn.
I’m still here — I’m still moving on.

And if tomorrow looks the same
Another door without my name
I’ll lace my will and try again.

Not because I’m sure I’ll win.

But because I already did.

I did not break.
I did not quit.
They wrote my end.
I outlived it.

They swore my aim was capped by proof.
Turns out I was built without a roof.

title: Beyond My View
lyrics:
I learned to speak to empty space
With folded hands and careful grace
A quiet script I memorized
For something watching from the sky

I called into a distant glow
A voice I swore I’d always know
But every word I sent out there
Just echoed back to empty air

I traced the dark for any sign
That something listened to what was mine

I sent my voice into the light
But nothing answered through the night

So I imagined something more
A different shape, a hidden door
Something beneath my skin that grew
A sense I wasn’t meant for what I knew

A world where I was not this place
Not held inside borrowed space
Not bound to where I learned to stand
But by something that was always planned

If I was never meant to stay
Then maybe silence was the way

I changed the shape of what I’d call
But nothing ever reached at all

I asked the questions I could form
Of something vast, of something warm
But every answer circled back
To trust the things I said I lacked

I learned that asking had a line
Where thought became a fault, not mine
Where knowing more was something wrong
And quiet meant that you belonged

So I stood still and held my tongue
And hid the thoughts I knew I’d spun

I couldn’t force myself to see
What wouldn’t stand in front of me

They said the source of everything
Could hear the smallest voice I bring
That something endless, something wide
Could hold a life like mine inside

But I have seen how small we are
A grain beneath a distant star
A fleeting breath, a passing trace
A life too small to take up space

And still I’m told that something vast
Would know me fully, hold me fast

I don’t know how to make that real
Without denying what I feel

There are a thousand roads to take
A thousand names, a thousand stakes
Each one convinced it holds the truth
Each one defining proof as proof

And if the cost of being wrong
Is endless nights where you don't belong
Then how could anyone decide
Which voice is truth and which ones lie

I stand before a fractured sky
With too many ways to be denied

I don’t know how to choose a name
When all of them demand the same

And still beneath it, something stays
A quiet pull I can’t erase
A sense that maybe something’s there
Just out of reach of thought or prayer

Not gone, not silent out of spite
Just somewhere past my line of sight
Not something I can prove or trace
But something I still want to face

Because I never wanted less
Than something more than emptiness

If you're there beyond my view
I don’t know how to reach for you

title: Shown the Way
lyrics:
I hear your voice through walls and air
It cuts a path from everywhere
You name each turn before I move
I still step towards what I can’t prove

The space is thick, the lines aren’t clear
I only know you’re somewhere near
You say the way is straight and true
But I can’t see the way you do

I move because you said to go
Not because I fully know

You show the path I need to take
And still I walk through what may break

The way ahead won’t stay in line
Each step I take could misalign
No steady line beneath my feet
Just something telling me repeat

Each step I take could be the last
A fragile line I’m walking past
You never force, you never bind
You only place it in my mind

A direction drawn but not defined
Something I follow half-blind

You show the way but not the ground
I still step forward without sound

The walls fall back, the space expands
A restless pull beneath my hands
A distant point cuts through the black
A single line I can’t turn back

It doesn’t calm the waves I face
It doesn’t slow the shifting pace
It only marks a place to steer
While everything stays unclear

No promise that the storm will break
Just something telling me which way

The light is there, it cuts the night
But doesn’t make the water right

The wind still pulls against my frame
The path ahead looks just the same
No clearer view, no steady sign
Just something telling me it’s mine

You never said I’d always see
Exactly where each step would be
You never said the road was clear
Or free from weight or free from fear

Only that I should move ahead
And trust the words that have been said

You gave a voice I chose to hear
Even when the way’s unclear

I still don’t see the end in sight
Or know if every step is right
But something in me stays aligned
With every word you leave behind

Not proof enough to make it known
But more than anything I’ve shown
A quiet pull I can’t deny
That keeps me moving towards your sky

You showed the way — which road to take
Through every step that cuts and breaks

title: Meant to Be
lyrics:
I spent my time on what I knew
A path I thought I’d follow through
The same direction, same intent
And still I saw no sign it went

I gave it time, I gave it weight
Kept trying hard to anticipate
effort rewards , or so I thought
But nothing came from what I wrought

It never shifted, just stayed the same
different days, the same old frame

To much effort to recall
Just stopped reaching out at all
Worn down by how it played out
Tired of what it brought about

I let it go, I let it rest
The path I thought was the best
No final word, no bitter end
Just effort I could not defend

And right when I had stepped astray
Something else just found its way

Not something I had known before
But resonated to my core
A different door, a different view
Something I never thought I’d do

But still it stood, a way ahead
I pray it’s not a path misled

And I just stopped and took it in
Not sure of where this might begin

Because I know how this can go
How things can shift to and fro
I’ve seen enough to hesitate
Before I call it something great

But still it came at just that time
Right when I reached the end of my line
And maybe that’s enough to see
That this might be meant to be

I don’t know where this one will lead
Or if it’s everything I need
But something in it feels like more
Than anything I had before

Not proof that this is meant to be
But it’s close enough for me

To take a step, and try to mend
Without predicting how it ends
Not chasing what I thought I’d find
Or begging just to rewind

And if it holds, I’ll see it through
And if it breaks, I’ll face that too
But I won’t stay where I gave in
Just fearing what could come again

Because right now that’s all I need
Not certainty — just room to breathe

title: Finally Me
lyrics:
I stayed within a measured line
A version shaped by what felt fine
A voice that never reached too far
A life that fit what others are

I kept it safe, I kept it small
No risk of rise, no chance to fall
A steady path I could defend
That led me nowhere in the end

I knew that something wasn’t right
A quiet pull I’d always fight

I stayed inside what I could be
But never close to finding me

It wasn’t fear of failing hard
Or losing ground or falling far
It wasn’t even fear of loss
Or paying any kind of cost

It was the thought of being seen
Without a frame to hide between
No practiced lines, no guarded face
No way to soften or replace

The version I had always shown
With something real I couldn’t own

There’s something more than what they see
And something more within me

So now I step beyond that line
Without a map to say it’s fine
No promise that this path will lead
To anything I thought I’d need

I know the odds, I know the fall
I know how this could cost it all
But something in me won’t agree
To live as less than I could be

Even if it all breaks apart
At least it starts from my heart

I don’t know where this path will lead
But something in me won’t concede

No mask to wear, no role to play
No need to filter what I say
No second guess on every move
Or shaping what I try to prove

Just something honest, something clear
A version I can keep right here
Not built to fit or stay in line
But something that is fully mine

But if it breaks, I’ll let it go
Not something shaped to fit a role

Even then, I'll finally see
That what I chose was finally me

title: Binding String
lyrics:
I thought the lines were drawn at birth
By name, by blood, by given worth
A place that should have felt like home
But never did, I stood alone

A shape I tried to fit inside
That never once would fall in line
I stayed within what I was told
But something there never took hold

I thought that love was tied to name
But none of it felt quite the same

You came along without a claim
No shared design, no binding name
No reason carved in anything
That said you owed me what I’d bring

No history you had to keep
No cost that made it feel too steep
Just something simple, something clear
You stayed, and you were simply here

You stood where you could walk away
But chose to stay, and chose to stay

I kept expecting something back
A cost, a shift, a hidden lack
A moment where it all would turn
And prove there’s always something earned

I watched for cracks, I watched for change
For something slipping out of range
For proof that it would fade like all
The things I knew before this call

I kept expecting it to end
Like everything I’d known back then

The days went on, the shape held true
No shift in what you chose to do
No debt implied, no balance kept
No silent terms that slowly crept

And slowly something changed in me
Not loud, not sudden, not set free
Just something loosening its hold
On what I thought was always told

You chose me without anything
No blood, no name, no binding string

And I still hesitate to trust
Something that stands without a cost
A part of me still looks for why
Or waits for something to deny

But something quieter stays near
A steady truth that doesn’t disappear
Not forced, not proved, not questioned through
Just something I can finally view

And maybe that’s what I can see
You chose this place — and you chose me

I don’t need more than what this is
No rewrite of what once was missed
No balance drawn, no equal weight
No need to justify or state

Just something real that’s here to stay
Not depending on what I gave away
A presence that remained the same
Without a reason, without a name

I’ll let it stand for what it is
Not what I doubt — but what it gives

title: Freely Given
lyrics:
I’ve seen what reaching hands can mean
A hidden cost beneath the seen
A favor framed as something kind
That leaves a heavier debt behind

I learned to measure every give
By what it takes to let me live
No open door without a catch
only offered help with strings that match

I kept my ground, I held my line
If it was mine, it stayed as mine
No borrowed breath, no shared demand
I’d rather fall than take a hand

I don’t know how to take what’s freely given
Without expecting something hidden

You didn’t push, you didn’t pry
You didn’t need a reason why
You stood the same through every doubt
And never tried to cash it out

No shifting tone, no subtle claim
No quiet score beside my name
No weight attached to what you gave
No quiet threat beneath the save

But every instinct in me pulls
To read the space for hidden tolls
To brace for terms I cannot see
Or debts that circle back to me

I don’t know how to take what’s freely given
Without expecting something hidden
Every hand I’ve known before
Had something hidden at its core

If I accept — then what am I?
The man who needed help to try?
The one who couldn’t stand alone
Who needed strength that wasn’t his own?

I fought too hard to build this ground
To let that old version come back around
To slip again, to lose that fight
To trade my will for something light

But standing here, I see it clear
This isn’t built from doubt or fear
This isn’t something I must earn
Or something waiting for return

I don’t know how to take what’s freely given
Without expecting something hidden
But maybe not all hands that reach
Are waiting just to take from me

This isn’t rescue, not a save
Not pulling me back to a grave
Not turning me back to who I was
Or undoing all that I’ve become

It’s just a hand that chose to stay
Not one that takes, then turns away
Not something I’m required to be
Just space to stand beside, still me

And maybe trust is not a fall
Or losing strength, or losing all
Maybe it’s choosing — even then
To take the hand, and still stand as I am

I don’t know how to take what’s freely given
Without expecting something hidden
But I can choose — despite the fear
To take the hand that’s offered here

It won’t erase the path I made
Or strip the ground I’ve already claimed
I won’t become who I outgrew
Just because I leaned on you

This doesn’t bind me, doesn’t break
The ground beneath the steps I take
It doesn’t steal the strength I’ve earned
Or undo everything I’ve learned

It’s just a choice I never knew
A different way to follow through
Not standing less, not giving in
Just letting something else begin

I don’t know how to take what’s freely given
Without expecting something hidden
But I will learn, though I resist
To take the hand I would have missed

title: Left Unspoken
lyrics:
When I was young it came with ease
Running home and climbing knees
Saying “love you” every night
Never scared to hold on tight

It was just us for quite awhile
You carried pain but wore a smile
And every night before I slept
You made me feel safe as you wept

Back then the words came naturally
Before they started leaving me

As I got older things grew strange
Little pieces started to change
Hugs got shorter over time
Simple words grew hard to find

You still reached out the way you could
And I still cared the way I should
But somewhere in those quiet years
I learned to hide away my fears

Not all at once, not suddenly
Just less of who I used to be

Then came years I barely spoke
Everything inside made me choke
Not just with you but everyone
Like something in me had gone numb

I stopped returning words I heard
Stopped speaking those precious words
Even when I knew you cared
I struggled showing feelings there

I know that distance had grown
Even if it had never shown

As time moved on I slowly thawed
Stopped seeing love as something flawed
Not all at once, not perfectly
Just pieces I shared earnestly

I learned that silence doesn’t mean
The absence of what isn't seen
And all the things I locked away
Were always here to stay

They stayed with me through every year
Even when I hid my tears

now I want to say these things
And see the joy that they bring
I still don’t reach the way I should
The way I wish I always could

But every call I  hesitate
Every moment that I wait
Comes from caring more than shown
Not from wanting to be alone

I’m still learning how to convey
The things I always meant to say

I still don’t say the things I should
The way I wish I always could
All the things we thought were broken
Still live within what I’ve left unspoken

title: Need Me To Be
lyrics:
I learned your name before I knew
What something close was meant to do
A place beside, a space we shared
A role I never questioned there

You said the word like it was true
A name that settled into you
I never fought it when you spoke
But something in me never closed

I stood inside what you could see
But not the way you looked at me

I stood where you could always reach
never where your eyes could breach

The years went on, the shape held tight
The same two roles, the same two sides
I knew before I understood
That something in me never could

I saw you drift, I saw you fall
Through things I couldn’t name at all
I stayed the same, I didn’t move
Not something I could risk or lose

I kept the line you needed clear
And never crossed it standing here

I stayed where I was safe to be
Not where I wanted you to see

The nights got loud, the lights got dim
The world you chose pulled you within
I watched you fade through borrowed air
And stood unchanged, still standing there

The faces came, the faces went
Each one a different kind of bent
I never spoke, I never tried
Just held the place right at your side

Not judging what you had to chase
Just knowing I don’t fit that space

I watched you drift through everything
And stayed the same, where you could lean

I know the ways I could be more
Than anything you’ve known before
But I’m not built for where you go
Or what you chase or what you show

I couldn’t be the life you live
Or meet you where you choose to give
I’m something else, a different line
A steadier ground you never define

And maybe that’s the truth I see
I’m not the place you’d choose for me

I’m not the life you’re drawn to live
Just someone steady when it gives

And now we stand where we have been
The same two roles we’re standing in
No shift in shape, no change in tone
Just something quietly overgrown

I know the step I’ve never made
words I’ve buried,  but won’t let fade
Not out of fear, not out of doubt
But knowing what they’d turn inside out

Because the line is not unclear
It’s something you still need right here

I could step forward, change the line
But what you need matters more than what is mine

So I remain where I have stayed
The same quiet role I’ve always played
Not less than what I feel inside
Just something I have set aside

Not something broken, not denied
Just something I don’t let decide
The place I stand, the space I keep
A version of me you won’t see weep

And maybe that’s what this will be
Not what I want — but what you see

I’ll stay where you need me to be
Even if that’s all you’ll ever see in me

title: Of Two Minds
lyrics:
Nothing here was built to last
Everything just fades too fast
You’ve seen it break, you know the end
It always bends, it never mends

Maybe so, but I’m still here
That hasn’t changed across the years
You call it proof it all will fall
I say I’ve outlasted it all

You say it’s set, I say we’ll see
You say that’s how it has to be

Of two minds, they both remain
But only one I will maintain

You say it slips, it always will
That nothing ever stays still
You’ve watched it fall too many times
You’ve learned the shape of all the signs

Then let it fall, I’ll build again
That doesn’t mean it has to end
You say collapse is all you see
I say it’s proof I still can be

You say the past will always win
You say I’ll end where I begin

Of two minds, they both remain
But only one I will maintain

You know how easy this could break
One step too far, one choice to make
You’ve stood that edge, you’ve seen that fall
You know how fast it ends it all

I’ve seen it too, I know that place
I know the pull I used to chase
But knowing that is why I stay
And choose a different path today

You say it’s close, it’s always near
You say it’s stronger than I fear

Of two minds, they both remain
But only one I will maintain

It doesn’t matter what you build
In time it cracks, in time it yields
You put it back, it falls again
That’s how it’s always been

Then let it break, I’ll build it new
That doesn’t make the effort untrue
You call it pointless, call it waste
I call it something I can face

You say the end is always set
I say that hasn’t happened yet

Of two minds, they both remain
But only one I will maintain

You’ll never silence what I say
I’ll always find another way
You think you’ve changed, but I remain
The same old voice inside your brain

You’re right, you’re never going to fade
You’re part of every step I’ve made
But being there is not control
You don’t decide my final role

You say I bend, I say I stand
You say I break, I say I can

Of two minds, they both remain
But only one I will maintain

And even now you still return
In quieter ways that twist and turn
Not sharp enough to make me spin
But close enough to pull me in

You don’t need force to make me sway
You only need one careless day
You speak in ways I almost miss
In passing thoughts that still persist

You say it’s truth, I say it’s noise
You say I fall, I make the choice

Of two minds, they both remain
But only one I will maintain

You tell me none of this will last
That I’m just running from the past
That everything will circle back
And put me right into that track

Maybe it will, maybe it won’t
But I won’t feed what it promotes
Ill Face it again when it appears
I’ve stood through worse across the years

You say I’ll slip, I say I might
But I won’t give you  control tonight

Of two minds, they both remain
But only one I will maintain

You’re still a shadow in my head
Not something buried with the dead
You shaped the ground beneath my feet
But not the road I choose to keep

And I don’t need to make you gone
To prove that I can still move on
You can exist without the lead
You can speak without the need

You say you'll stay, I know you do
But I decide when to follow through

Of two minds, they both remain
But only one I will maintain

title: Let it Die
lyrics:
I used to walk a thinner line
Where breath itself felt hard to find
A place where days would blur and bend
And I could not see past the end

Rooms with walls that closed in tight
Long empty hours without light
A version I could not defend
Who didn’t think that it would end

I buried that beneath the years
Outran the weight, outgrew the fears
Built something stronger, something clear
A life that finally kept me here

Ten years passed without that voice
No second guess, no darker choice
A distance I could finally see
Between that past and what was me

I thought that part was left behind
A broken piece I’d redefined
Something I’d never have to face
Or hear again in any place

But then it came without a sound
No crash, no shift, no pulling down
Just something quiet in my head
“you’d be better off dead”

Not loud enough to take control
Not something reaching for my soul
But strong enough to make me see
That it still had a place in me

And I was angry it was there
After the work, the years, the care
How could it find its way back through
Like nothing I had built was true

I sat with it, I let it stay
But didn’t let it lead the way
Because a thought is not a choice
And I don’t have to give it voice

It didn’t win, it didn’t lead
It didn’t turn to what I’d be
It came and went, it passed me by
And I was still here, I let it die

So if it comes again someday
I know it doesn’t get to stay
It doesn’t take what I have built
Or turn my strength to fear or guilt

Because the truth I’ve come to see
Is strength is not immunity
It’s knowing when the ground gives way
You stand back up and choose to stay

title: Set it Down
lyrics:
I carried you in everything
In every thought, in every sting
A quiet weight I learned to keep
That followed me when I tried to sleep

It shaped the way I spoke my name
It tied itself to every blame
A constant thread I couldn’t cut
A door I swore I’d never shut

I held it close like it was mine
A truth I didn’t redefine
As if the anger made me whole
Or gave me back some lost control

I held your weight like it was mine
A constant truth I couldn’t unwind

It took more time than I could see
More breath than it returned to me
A steady drain I never named
A quiet fire I always blamed

It lived in things that had no part
Still found its way into my heart
Not loud, not wild, not always seen
Just always there — and in between

And one day sitting side by side
I felt that weight I couldn’t hide
Not sharper then, not more severe
Just heavier than any year

This took from me more than from you
And I kept paying like it was due

You didn’t ask. You didn’t know.
How far I’d let that hatred grow
How long I’d carried what you did
In ways I never even hid

And in that moment something broke
Not like a snap — more like a slow
Unraveling of something tight
That finally loosened in the light

I looked at you — no rise, no flame
No need to win, no need to blame
No speech prepared, no grand excuse
Just something I could finally choose

I said it plain. I said it true.
“You know what? I forgive you.”

I set it down. I let it fall.
It doesn’t own me anymore.

It didn’t change what came before
It didn’t settle any score
It didn’t fix or make it right
Or take the past out of my sight

I still remember what was done
The things you said, the things you’d spun
The way it shaped the years I knew
That part of it is still all true

But I don’t carry it the same
It doesn’t sit behind my name
It doesn’t live inside my breath
Or linger at the edge of death

I set it down. It stays behind.
It’s no longer mine to define.

This wasn’t something that you earned
Or something balanced, something turned
No scale was tipped, no debt was cleared
No sudden peace, no vanished fear

It wasn’t for the past we had
Or anything that made it bad
It wasn’t something meant for you
It was just something I had to do

Because I couldn’t live like that
With something always pulling back
With something always taking space
From every step I tried to place

I set it down. I chose to leave
What never once chose me to keep.

I didn’t say it to repair
Or act like something wasn’t there
I didn’t say it to pretend
Or try to make something mend

I said it just to let it go
To take back something you don’t own
To draw a line I hadn’t drawn
And still move forward, still move on

And now it sits where it belongs
Not gone — just not what carries on
A piece of what my life has been
But not the weight I live within

I set it down — and it stays there
No longer mine to hold or bear.

title: To See Who I Became
lyrics:
knew the sound your footsteps made
And how often I sat and prayed
The rumble of your truck outside
And fear I never learned to hide

I learned to keep my voice in line
To read the room before the sign
A younger me could never tell
What version of you came to yell

Some nights your anger crossed too far
And left its mark like a hidden scar
Words spoken hard, a raised right hand
More weight than I could understand

I carried that through growing years
Turned all that hurt into my fears
And for a long time all I knew
Was every wound I tied to you

I thought the anger was the whole
The only truth within my soul
I never stopped to ask what weight
Could turn a man so hard with hate

You worked through nights that never slowed
Through frozen storms and chains you'd throw
Countless hours without a  moment to breathe
Still came back home and didn’t leave

You carried more than I could name
Bills, long hours, and constant strain
A house that pulled from every side
And nowhere safe to set it aside

I see it clearer looking back
Even home there was no slack
No quiet place to let things go
No steady ground beneath your soul

That doesn’t make the hard parts right
Or change that those years took flight
But growing older let me see
what The man beneath the anger could be

Because outside the worst of that
You still gave all the strength you had
You kept the lights, you kept us fed
You showed up tired, but still you bled

And even when I pulled away
Spent years with nothing left to say
You never forced me to explain
Or tried to turn my hurt to shame

I know I made that distance wide
Let bitterness become my guide
There were years I shut you out
Years defined by fear and doubt

But time can shift what once felt clear
And age can change the things you hear
The older that I came to be
The more your burdens came to me

Not every choice I understood
Or every way you handled things was good
But life became less black and white
I stopped being bound so tight

I never saw what staying meant
The years you gave, the way they went
How many times you could have gone
But still woke up and carried on

And though the years were hard to see
You never turned your back on me

Some pain runs deeper than one hand
Or things a child can understand
The older that I came to be
The less it traced to only thee

Not every wound was yours to blame
You stayed to see who I became

title: Carry On
lyrics:
The road ahead splits left and right
And neither choice feels right to my sight
One path asks me to stay and wait
One asks me to embrace my fate

I turn them over in my head
Long after I should be in bed
Every answer leads to more
Than what I understood before

The weight of every choice I've drawn
Makes me too tired to carry on

Too tired to carry on
Too tired to carry on
Another day, another dawn
And I'm too tired to carry on

The work I have is wearing thin
The work ahead may box me in
One offers safety at a cost
One risks becoming something lost

Then somewhere else a door appears
Built from equal parts hope and fear
A chance to build the life I want
Or watch another dream grow gaunt

I weigh the risks, I count them all
And still can't see which way I'll fall

Too tired to carry on
Too tired to carry on
The road keeps stretching ever long
And I'm too tired to carry on

The pills may help me find my ground
But every answer circles round
One problem solved, another waits
Standing watch beside the gates

I know what happens if they work
I know the burdens that may lurk
The future shifts from day to day
And every plan can slip away

Some nights the doubts grow far too strong
And I'm barely holding on

I'm barely holding on
I'm barely holding on
The storm keeps pushing me along
And I'm barely holding on

I've stood in places just as dark
Where every hope had lost its spark
I've faced the nights that wouldn't end
And found a way to rise again

The years behind me leave their proof
High school, college, every truth
Every voice that said I'd fail
Now echoes weak and growing pale

I've heard those verdicts all along
And still somehow I've carried on

I know I'll carry on
I know I'll carry on
No matter what may still go wrong
I know I'll carry on

The answers may not come today
The fear may never fade away
The weight may still be mine to bear
And certainty may not be there

But looking back across the years
Past all the doubt and all the fears
The lesson written clear and strong
Is every time I've carried on

title: Finally Human
lyrics:
For years I packed with room to spare
Kept every burden light to bear
If something didn't fit the ride
It stayed behind or got denied

I never bought what couldn't move
Never put nails  just to prove
Every place was just a stop
Never somewhere that I'd drop

I thought that's just the way life ran
Never questioned why I'd planned
For every ending, every fall
Before I'd even built at all

Finally human, or so it seems
Making plans for next week
Finally human, or so it seems
My future no longer looks bleak

One day I caught myself looking round
At things I'd bought that weighed me down
A couch too wide, a weight set
The kind of stuff  I'd never get

If every road might end tomorrow
Or every smile still hid a sorrow
Funny how I never knew
What those things spoke to

A picture hanging on the wall
The future wasn't quite so small
Little signs I should've seen
Scattered through the in-between

Finally human, or so it seems
Making plans for next week
Finally human, or so it seems
Buying things I'm going to keep

I used to hide what I would feel
Like saying it would make it real
A laugh was measured, tears were rare
I'd lock them up and leave them there

Then somewhere in this passing year
I stopped apologizing for tears
Stopped checking every room I knew
For reasons I should see them through

I smiled one day and caught myself
Not doing it for someone else
No mask to wear, no role to play
Just glad to see another day

Finally human, or so it seems
Smiling without wondering why
Finally human, or so it seems
Looking people in the eye

Then one night sitting all alone
I looked around the life I'd grown
The things I'd built, the things I'd kept
The dreams that hadn't left me yet

And it occurred to me right then
The man I was and who I'd been
Would never recognize this place
Or the look upon my face

For years I lived prepared to run
Like peace was borrowed from someone
Like every good thing I'd received
Was something to be grieved

Finally human, now I can see
What changed wasn't the world around me
Finally human, now I believe
I stopped preparing to leave

Finally human, that's what it was
It snuck up on me just because
Finally human, now I can see
The life I wanted waiting on me

title: Immortal
lyrics:
The river never keeps its shape
Yet somehow defines the landscape
It leaves the mountain far behind
But never leaves itself in time

The forest falls beneath the snow
Yet feeds the roots under toe
What looked like loss from where I stood
Became the next year's living wood

I spent my life afraid of change
As if all endings stayed the same

We are Immortal
We are Immortal
Beyond the loss and all that changes
We are Immortal

The stars burn out beyond our sight
Yet send us echoes through the night
It fades from where it shone
and lights worlds never known

The wave dissolves upon the shore
Yet joins the waiting sea once more
No single crest survives the day
Yet none are ever washed away

I feared the dark beyond the frame
As if it swallowed every name

We are Immortal
We are Immortal
Beyond the loss and all that changes
We are Immortal

Some swear a kingdom waits beyond
Some say we circle and move on
Some say we're written in the stars
Or scattered through the dark afar

Some say our atoms never cease
But simply trade their form in peace
Some say the soul survives the flame
And wakes to wear another name

I do not know which road is true
Or what awaits beyond my view

We are Immortal
We are Immortal
Beyond the loss and all that changes
We are Immortal

The rain returns to mountain stone
Yet never truly travels lone
The flower falls beneath the frost
Yet feeds the roots that thought it lost

The light I see from distant skies
May come from stars that long since died
Yet still it finds its way to me
Across the vast eternity

Perhaps the fear I've carried long
Was built upon a vision wrong

We are Immortal
We are Immortal
Beyond the loss and all that changes
We are Immortal

Call it heaven if you choose
Call it something science proves
Call it spirit, dust, or flame
The ending always shifts its name

Call it memory, call it birth
Call it atoms crossing earth
Call it something we can't see
Still moving through eternity

The river never stays the same
Yet somehow easily tamed

We are Immortal
We are Immortal
Beyond the loss and all that changed
I am immortal

title: Named After Me
lyrics:
I must've been about five or six
When Nana pulled a funny trick
She brought a man I'd never seen
And said he'd joined the family tree

He smiled and shook my little hand
Then told me what his name was then
I laughed and said quite proudly
"That's neat, you're named after me"

The grown-ups laughed, I couldn't see
What was so funny it brought them glee

I thought you were named after me

Papa and Nana packed the truck
Most every summer we'd head up
A fishing pole, a .22
And all the things young boys should do

We'd build a fire as daylight died
